🔍 Real-time Monitoring

Continuously scans the aircraft market on configured servers, instantly detecting new listings

📋 Smart Rule Engine

Define purchase rules by aircraft family, type, price, age, condition, and lease rate

🤖 Automated Purchasing

Supports immediate purchase and auction bidding with configurable snatch and balance protection

🌐 Multi-Server & Multi-Account

Monitor multiple game servers simultaneously with independent authentication accounts

⚙️ Web Management UI

Full-featured dashboard for engine control, rule management, real-time logs, and settings

🚀 Single Binary

Go-compiled single binary with embedded Vue frontend — deploy anywhere with zero dependencies
